data.name: Murtadaa
data.gender_notes: Murtadaa is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who is loved by Allah and His Messenger (peace be upon him). One who is devoted and obedient to Allah. The name Murtadaa carries the meaning “One who is beloved” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Murtadaa usually hope their child will grow to embody one who is beloved and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To be loved by Allah and His Messenger is the greatest blessing.
data.etymology: Murtadaa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “One who is beloved.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Murtadaa total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: مرتضى

in_arabic.long_meaning: مرتضى هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه المختار، المرتضى من الله، راضى به من الله تعالى، و هو من الأسماء التي وردت في القرآن الكريم، و في الحديث النبوي الشريف، و يعني الشخص الذي ارتضاه الله و اختاره

in_urdu.name: مرتضی
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ کی رضا حاصل کرنے والا، مختار، مفضل
in_urdu.long_meaning: مرتضی ایک معروف نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے اللہ کی رضا حاصل کرنے والا، مختار، مفضل، یہ نام اہل سنت و جماعت کے دوسرے خلیفہ، حضرت عمر بن خطاب کے لقب ہے

It reflects the ideal of being a devoted and obedient Muslim, striving to live in accordance with the teachings of Islam. This name would instill a sense of reverence, respect and piety in the minds of those who are called by this name.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Murtadaa signifies the eternal love and mercy of Allah towards His creation. It serves as a reminder of the importance of pleasing Allah and the reward that comes with this obedience. The spiritual significance of this name is underpinned by the belief that by being loved by Allah and His Messenger (peace be upon him), one can achieve proximity to the divine and find peace and contentment in their spiritual journey.
